story:
Tropical South Landscaping is a Miami-Dade company that specialises in landscape and lawn maintenance. With over 12 years of experience, we have the skill to provide results that satisfy the most demanding clients. Whether you need landscape installation, tree care or lawn trimming, we are always here for you.

We are licensed and insured. We provide residential and commercial lawn care, tree work and landscape design services across South Florida, and we work with homeowners, commercial property owners and homeowner associations in accordance with your specifications. You can rest assured that when you put your home or commercial property maintenance into the hands of the Tropical South team, you will be taken care of.

**A message from the owner, Rafael Quezada.** Tropical South is committed to growing into a full-service company that offers both residential and commercial property owners a wide range of services, while providing excellent customer service and quality workmanship on every job. We will always strive to deliver professionalism with an exceptional work ethic.

Our employees are talented, dedicated individuals who share a common goal: customer satisfaction, and a commitment to providing the absolute best service possible. We continually work to set the standard for the green industry with a dedicated management team, responsive customer service, and crew members who strive for perfection in the field.

Our passion is to satisfy every client and leave a first and lasting impression. That comes down to four things we hold ourselves to: build a strong and lasting relationship with our clients; offer the most competitive and fair price in the market; provide every service with professionalism and quality workmanship; and imprint a first and lasting impression on every client.

Your satisfaction is our priority, and we strive to provide a service we are proud of. We start every project with a thorough consultation to understand your goals and the needs of the project, so the work is completed according to your preferences.

If you need tree work or landscaping services now or in the future, call us for a free estimate and expert professional advice.
